bio: A new and improved Café Boulud from Daniel Boulud has been beautifully reborn on the storied corner of 63rd street and Park Avenue with Executive Chef Romain Paumier at the helm. The setting is appropriately posh and exudes Art Deco vibes.Enjoy this unique prix fixe menu which highlights four inspirations: classic French cuisine; La Saison; vegetarian farmers' market dishes; and Le Voyage, offering an international focus. Choose one style of menu or handpick for a multicourse meal that is on-point with sharp execution and a soigné presentation.
